```{r}
dat <- read_csv("../../data/bainbridge et al/processed/data_processed_itemlevel_long.csv")

```

```{r}
data_s1 <- read_csv("../../data/bainbridge et al/raw/s1.csv")
```

# Range to SD ratio

CIs on M:

$$
m \pm t_{1-\alpha/2, n-1} \left( \frac{s}{\sqrt{n}} \right)
$$

CIs on SD:

$$
\left[ \frac{(n-1)s^2}{\chi^2_{\alpha/2, n-1}}, \frac{(n-1)s^2}{\chi^2_{1-\alpha/2, n-1}} \right]
$$

```{r}

# Function to calculate SD CI bounds
# Returns a tibble to allow for easy unnesting if desired, 
# or can be split into two functions.
calc_sd_ci <- function(x, conf_level = 0.95, side = "lower") {
  n <- sum(!is.na(x))
  df <- n - 1
  sd_val <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  alpha <- 1 - conf_level
  
  if (side == "lower") {
    # Chi-square upper critical value for the lower bound
    chi_val <- qchisq(1 - alpha/2, df)
    return(sqrt((df * sd_val^2) / chi_val))
  } else {
    # Chi-square lower critical value for the upper bound
    chi_val <- qchisq(alpha/2, df)
    return(sqrt((df * sd_val^2) / chi_val))
  }
}

dat_nitems <- dat |>
  count(id, scale, subscale) |>
  group_by(scale, subscale) |>
  summarize(n_items = median(n))

dat_sumscores <- dat |>
  group_by(id, scale, subscale) |>
  summarize(sumscore = sum(response, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(dat_nitems, by = c("scale", "subscale"))

res <- dat_sumscores |>
  group_by(scale, subscale, n_items) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            m = mean(sumscore),
            sd = sd(sumscore),
            # --- Mean CIs (using t-distribution) ---
            # Standard Error: sd / sqrt(n)
            se = sd / sqrt(n),
            # t-critical value for 95% CI
            t_crit = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
            m_lower = m - (t_crit * se),
            m_upper = m + (t_crit * se),
            sd_lower = calc_sd_ci(sumscore, side = "lower"),
            sd_upper = calc_sd_ci(sumscore, side = "upper"),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(min_possible = 1 * n_items,
         max_possible = 5 * n_items,
         max_range = max_possible - min_possible,
         pomp_m = m/max_range,
         romp_m = max_range/m,
         pomp_sd = sd/max_range,
         romp_sd = max_range/sd) |>
  select(-min_possible, -max_possible, -se, -t_crit) |> 
  relocate(sd, .before = sd_lower)

# table
res |>
  mutate_if(is.numeric, roundwork::round_up, digits = 2) |>
  kable() |>
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE)

```

# POMP SD & ROMP SD

```{r}

# plot
ggplot(res, aes(pomp_sd)) +
  geom_histogram(boundary = 0, binwidth = .025) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "POMP SD", limits = c(-.05, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = .1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Frequency", breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5)) +
  theme_linedraw()

# # different implementation of ROMP but same resulting value
# ggplot(res, aes(1/(sd / max_range))) + 
#   geom_histogram(boundary = 0.5, binwidth = 1) +
#   scale_x_continuous(name = "ROMP SD", breaks = 0:10) +
#   scale_y_continuous(name = "Frequency", breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5)) +
#   theme_linedraw()

# plot
ggplot(res, aes(romp_sd)) +
  geom_histogram(boundary = 0.5, binwidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Ratio of Maximum Possible SD (ROMP SD)\n(Max range:SD - 'How many SDs wide is the scale range?')", breaks = 0:10) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Frequency", breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5)) +
  theme_linedraw()

ggplot(res, aes(romp_sd/2)) +
  geom_histogram(boundary = 0.5, binwidth = .25) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Half-ROMP SD\nrule of thumb for max Cohen's d\n(Max change up or down assuming mean is roughly in the middle))", breaks = seq(0, 10, by = .5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Frequency", breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 5)) +
  theme_linedraw()

```

# POMP M

```{r}

ggplot(res, aes(pomp_m)) +
  geom_histogram(boundary = 0, binwidth = .025) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "POMP M", limits = c(-.05, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = .1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Frequency", breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 1)) +
  theme_linedraw()

```

# 95% CIs on M and SD



```{r}



res <- dat_sumscores |>
  group_by(scale, subscale, n_items) |>
  summarize(n = n(),
            m = mean(sumscore),
            sd = sd(sumscore),
            
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(min_possible = 1 * n_items,
         max_possible = 5 * n_items,
         max_range = max_possible - min_possible,
         pomp_m = m/max_range,
         romp_m = max_range/m,
         pomp_sd = sd/max_range,
         romp_sd = max_range/sd) |>
  select(-min_possible, -max_possible) |>
  relocate(max_range, .before = sd)

```
